about: Station cards, in each channel family's voice (web/js/cards.js says which channel is in which family). kickers: the line over the up-next card in a station break; {ch} is the channel number, {name} the channel, {time} when the next program starts. loading: what the card says while a channel's program loads. ad: lowercase quips for the sponsor card over a YouTube ad, mixed with the general ones. count: the label over the countdown. Picked from the clock, so every TV in the same break shows the same words. Edit freely; keep it clean.
